• 🛡️ Hardened Permission Setup: Critical SMS and Call Log permissions are strictly verified during download/setup and safeguarded with a persistent dashboard alert banner
• 💬 Unlocked AI Autopilot Retest: Immediate session refresh so you can test conversational replies without cooldown delays
• 🚀 1-Tap Unpause: Tap 'Unpause AI & Reset Cooldown' on any takeover notification to immediately resume automated text responses
